about: Topics of recent Shorts, for the 'From our videos' card the homepage shows to visitors who arrive from TikTok or Instagram (the profile link ?ref=tt-bio / ?ref=ig-bio, or those apps' in-app browsers). The card lists the newest 3 whose date has come (from 6pm local time on the posting day). Add one entry per Short when it is scheduled, then run node scripts/build-from-video.mjs. docs/from-video.md has the rules.

videos.hook: Your muscle shortens. Its filaments never do.
Your R might secretly be an S.
Wrong spot, and the tourniquet fails.
